shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab/pillar
animal or creature figures in profile
horizontal band or register dividing the surface
repeated row of similar motifs across the top
paired arm/hand-like elements bent over the front of the block
justification: Both are upright monolithic blocks carved in shallow relief with registers: an upper row of repeated arched/head-like motifs, a mid band, and below it discs and bent arm-like elements curving around toward the front, with small creature forms in profile in A and rounded relief bosses in B. The biggest difference in content is that B is dominated by an anthropomorphic figure with a head, face and torso whose ornament is subordinate to the body, whereas A is a flat panel of independent animal and abstract signs with no unifying human form.
